sentence: This project studies how tree roots and their microbial partners help mixed species forests share water and nutrients.
This project develops algorithms that learn which option to choose over time when getting information about an option has a cost.
This project studies the Higgs boson and neutrinos in particle physics experiments to ask whether new fundamental particles or interactions exist.
This project develops methods that use real-time sensing data to find defects in metal parts while they are made by additive manufacturing.
This project studies which school and community conditions help rural schools keep effective science and mathematics teachers.
This project explores cybersecurity problems, including adversarial attacks on robot vision systems and software reverse engineering.
This project develops a system that uses artificial intelligence and sound to detect wildlife and keep animals away from crops and gardens without causing harm.
This project builds open-source software that simulates fluid dynamics around wind turbines and helicopters using meshes that change as needed.
This project maps complex industry problems onto quantum processors and builds test-beds for quantum computing and quantum networks.
This project develops low-cost sensors that measure nitrogen signals in plants, soils and water in real time to detect nitrogen deficiency early.
This project designs polymer materials that capture harmful biological targets such as bacteria and viruses and uses machine learning to improve them.
This project tests whether concept maps make complex engineering problems mentally easier to solve, using a brain imaging technique to measure mental effort.
This project adds a nuclear magnetic resonance spectrometer that helps chemists work out the structure of molecules.
This project develops statistical machine learning tools that use neuronal spike train data to infer how neurons interact.
This project builds a computer simulation tool for modeling systems where biology and nanotechnology meet, including DNA nanostructures and viruses.
This project develops a catheter that controls how far and in which direction heat spreads in tissue to destroy tumors while preserving healthy tissues.
This project studies how households and infrastructure networks interact in disasters and why vulnerable groups face different risks.
